ear_source.use: The two source ear components were extracted from head_org_0_0_node and parented to CC_Base_Head.

walk_adjustments.arm_trajectory: analytic two-bone retiming; lateral 0.58, longitudinal 1.30, right longitudinal multiplier 1.327
walk_adjustments.finger_animation: 24 finger bones frozen at first-frame rotation
walk_adjustments.leg_stride: analytic two-bone retiming; negative-Y rear stride is 80% to reduce the side-view rear-foot projection
walk_adjustments.ear_placement: Miku-derived ears uniformly scaled to 85%; total world -Y forward offset 0.145; outer rim pivots toward face around the root, world-Z 40 degrees; root band is projected to the side-head surface with 0.006 outward separation

known_limitations: Side-view rear-foot silhouette can still appear longer because of stride projection and overlap, though the rear-stride 80% retiming reduces it.
This package intentionally contains the selected walk baseline only. Run is preserved as a source FBX for the next retarget pass.
